policy.verified_relation: Same physical artwork only; selected photograph remains independently curated
policy.negative_relation: Explicit physical-object nonidentity prevents title/artist-only merging
policy.matching_restrictions: No automatic merge from artist, translated title or iconography. Museum inventory, holding institution, direct historical source or visual composition must support physical identity.
